lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Go at once to Zarephath in Sidon. I have directed a widow there to provide for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the town gate Elijah found a widow gathering sticks. She was preparing what she believed would be the last meal for herself and her son.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: Please bring me a little water—and while you are going, bring me a small piece of bread.

choices.label: Trust God's promise
choices.note: The widow is asked to trust before she can see the provision.

choices.label: Hold on to what little remains
choices.note: Her fear is understandable. She has almost nothing left, yet God's provision is about to become visible.

lines.speaker: widow
lines.text: I have no bread. Only a handful of flour and a little oil. I was gathering sticks to prepare one final meal for my son and me.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: Do not be afraid. The LORD says the flour will not run out and the oil will not fail until rain returns to the land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She trusted the word of the LORD. Day after day there was enough flour and oil for Elijah, the widow, and her household.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then tragedy struck: the widow's son became ill and died. Elijah carried the boy upstairs, prayed to the LORD, and pleaded for his life.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: LORD my God, let this child's life return to him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The LORD heard Elijah's prayer. The child's life returned, and Elijah brought him back to his mother.

lines.speaker: widow
lines.text: Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is true.
